author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before: a cramped cube whose top face and sides nearly closed up, short stubby spokes, and r3 node rings that painted as donuts with pin holes. After: a cleaner isometric cube with open faces (1:1.6 face slopes, 10-unit verticals), longer spokes, and solid round node discs at top, bottom-left and bottom-right like the reference's circles.
omissions: Node circles are solid discs rather than hollow rings: hollow rings large enough to read as open need a gap that shrinks the cube below legibility.
